cases.explain: «Ленивые руки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

cases.explain: «разумный сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

cases.explain: «Лживые губы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
